thread:
opsbot: Incident 1768504 triggered: high tail-latency on inference-prod-us-west at 03:12 UTC. Pager sent to @cheng and @sara
cheng: saw the alerts, jumping in. preliminary: async queue backlog + one KS node OOM suspected
sara: I'm on the bridge, digging into logs now. will post timeline shortly :hourglass_flowing_sand:
opsbot: Bridge created: #incident-1768504 (link)
dave: FYI customer support flagged 3 customers with >10% error rate in US-WEST; customer IDs in ticket INC-9981
cheng: short mitigation: drained node node-7, restarted model service, cleared backlog. latency back to normal at 03:26 UTC
sara: good. collecting artifacts: pod logs, kube events, profiling snapshot. will attach in the doc
raj: assigning post-incident writeup: can someone own draft RCA + timeline? want to schedule postmortem review Thurs 10am PT
dave: I can own the customer-impact section and coordinate CS comms
cheng: I'll draft technical timeline and contributing factors. pinging @melissa for peer review on mitigation correctness
melissa: can review. prefer a short timeline table and explicit list of follow-ups. Also confirm whether this node OOM is correlated with a recent kernel patch
sara: quick timeline (raw):
```
03:11:58 ALERT: tail latency spike >500ms
03:12:10 Pager -> cheng, sara
03:14:04 Queue backlog increasing on shard-3
03:18:30 node-7 OOM kill (killed model-worker)
03:20:05 Drained node-7
03:22:13 Restarted model-worker on node-7
03:26:40 Latency returned to baseline
03:45:00 Bridge closed, mitigation verified
```
raj: thanks. action items proposed: 1) add OOM monitoring + node auto-drain (owner: cheng, due: 1 week) 2) add load-shedding at ingress when queue depth > 75% (owner: sara, due: 2 weeks) 3) customer follow-up email draft (owner: dave, due: 48 hrs) 4) infra postmortem on node-7 kernel patch correlation (owner: melissa, due: 1 week)
melissa: for 4) I'll need kernel patch rollout logs and node provisioning history. tagging infra team. I'll review draft RCA Wed afternoon
cheng: starting the RCA doc in /docs/postmortems/1768504321-draft.md, will paste initial sections here when ready. kept minimal: summary, timeline, contributing factors, action items, evidence links
sara: small request: can we add a customer impact metric in the summary: total requests failed = ~37k, affected endpoints: /v1/generate, error class: 5xx and timeouts
dave: noted. CS will add impacted customer list and send preliminary outreach by EOD
opsbot: Reminder: postmortem template checklist not completed for this thread
raj: assigning peer reviewers: @melissa (infra), @dave (customer impact), plus one reader from platform (TBD). After peer review we'll route to eng leadership for sign-off
melissa: I'll review infra section and verify evidence. if kernel correlation is true, recommend hold on that kernel on deploys and add canary guardrails
cheng: uploaded logs: https://redwood.internal/s3/postmortems/1768504/logs.tar.gz and profiling snapshot link
sara: draft timeline pasted to doc and added proof links. starting contributing factors section: 1) node memory fragmentation after long-running model-worker process, 2) insufficient proactive drain based on queue depth, 3) recent node kernel bump (suspected)
dave: customer impact note added to doc + draft outreach email. sending to CS for review
raj: let's lock reviewers by EOD tomorrow. target sign-off next Mon. who will do the final sign-off? leadership? I can shepherd to eng-ops leads
melissa: I can provisionally sign off infra findings after my review. final sign-off from eng-ops + product makes sense
sara: thanks everyone. I pinged infra and CS. Cheng, please drop the mitigation runbook snippet in the doc so ops can implement auto-drain quickly
cheng: will do. quick runbook snippet: 
```
if queue_depth > 0.75 * max_depth:\n  set node.drain=true
  scale up spare nodes by 1
  throttle new requests with 429 + Retry-After
```
melissa: looks good, prefer exponential backoff guidance in client, but runbook ok
dave: CS will prioritize customer outreach and set expectation for follow-up once RCA is finalized
raj: final ask: add proposed owners and due dates to the RCA doc as separate bullet list. I'll update the postmortem calendar invite to Thurs 10am PT for the review while we prepare the draft
melissa: reviewing Wed 2pm PT. will leave comments in the doc
sara: thanks all — I'll close this thread once the RCA draft has reviewers assigned and links are attached
melissa: comment: add mitigation verification metrics (latency p95 before/after, error rate drop)
cheng: added p95 numbers and graphs to the doc
dave: outreach sent to affected customers, included link to interim status page
raj: closing loop: reviewers = melissa, dave, product (tbd). target sign-off: Mon EOD. action owners and due dates are in doc. good work everyone :tada:
